# Hand-assemble the CHIP-8 demo ROM and verify it as a self-checking program.

I = []  # list of ints (bytes)

def emit(*bs):
    for b in bs:
        assert 0 <= b <= 0xFF, b
        I.append(b)

def op(w):
    emit((w >> 8) & 0xFF, w & 0xFF)

def addr(a):
    return a

# ---- layout ----
# 0x200: header + sprite init
# 0x210: main loop
# 0x220: handlers
# sprites at 0x280 / 0x288
SPRITE = 0x280
TITLE  = 0x288

# header
op(0x00E0)              # 200 CLS
op(0x6005)              # 202 V0 = 5   x
op(0x610A)              # 204 V1 = 10  y
op(0x6204)              # 206 V2 = 4   w
op(0x6304)              # 208 V3 = 4   h
op(0xA280)              # 20A A = 0x280 sprite
op(0xD013)              # 20C DRW V0,V1,3
op(0x6400)              # 20E V4 = 0   score

# title loop (draw + erase, so it blinks)
# 210
op(0xA288)              # 210 A = title
op(0xD013)              # 212 draw title
op(0x650C)              # 214 V5 = 12  (delay)
op(0xF515)              # 216 DT = V5
op(0xF507)              # 218 wait DT == 0
op(0xA288)              # 21A A = title
op(0xD013)              # 21C erase title
op(0x650C)              # 21E V5 = 12
# 220
op(0xF515)              # 220 DT = V5
op(0xF507)              # 222 wait DT == 0
op(0x6600)              # 224 V6 = 0   pressed mask
op(0xE09E)              # 226 if V0 key4 pressed -> V0 += 1
op(0x7001)
op(0xE19E)              # 22C if V1 key6 pressed -> V1 += 1
op(0x7101)
op(0xE29E)              # 232 if V2 key8 pressed -> V2 += 1
op(0x7201)
op(0xE39E)              # 238 if V3 keyA pressed -> V3 += 1
op(0x7301)
# 23E erase sprite
op(0xA280)              # 23E A = sprite
op(0xD013)              # 240 DRW V0,V1,3 (erase)
# 242 clamp x: if V0 > 60 -> V0 = 60   (8xy4 sets VF)
op(0x653C)              # 242 V5 = 60
op(0x8054)              # 244 V0 += V5 ; VF=1 if carry (V0 > 60)
op(0x6000)              # 246 V0 = 0

    LD  A, SPRITE

    LD  A, TITLE
    DRW V0, V1, 3      ; draw title (ON)
    LD  V5, 12
    LD  DT, V5
wait1:
    LD  V5, DT
    SNE V5, 0
    JP  wait1

    LD  V5, 12

    SKNP 8
    ADD V2, 1
